leer.label: Leer Low German
leer.model_formula: F0_ST_re100 ~ Length * Environment + s(time_norm, by = LengthEnvironment, bs = 'cr', k = 7) + s(time_norm, Speaker, bs = 'fs', m = 1, k = 5) + s(time_norm, WordPair, bs = 'fs', m = 1, k = 5) + s(Speaker, by = OL, bs = 're') + s(MatchedSet, bs = 're')
leer.method_note: mgcv::bam fREML with tokenwise AR(1). The model input linearly interpolated each token to 11 normalized-time positions. Population predictions exclude speaker, word-pair, and matched-set random terms.

aachen.label: Aachen Franconian
aachen.model_formula: f0_st ~ accent * context + s(time_norm, by = accent_context, k = 8) + s(time_norm, speaker, bs = 'fs', m = 1, k = 5) + s(time_norm, word_pair, bs = 'fs', m = 1, k = 5) + s(speaker, bs = 're') + s(word_pair, bs = 're')
aachen.method_note: mgcv::bam fREML with tokenwise AR(1), using 11 source positions per vowel; missing F0 positions were omitted. Population predictions exclude speaker and word-pair random terms.
